author: Marlon Chaviano
name: waitlist-next
title: Waitlist with Next.js
description: The Next.js landing page with a working waitlist: a form with a Server Action, validation and contact sign-up in Resend. To validate an idea before building it.
setupTasks: Resend: create an audience at resend.com/audiences and put its id in `RESEND_AUDIENCE_ID` (and the API key in `RESEND_API_KEY`).
instructions:
## Waitlist

- The form (`src/components/waitlist-form.tsx`) calls the `joinWaitlist` Server Action (`src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`), which validates the email with Zod and adds it to the Resend audience.
- The Resend key is only used on the server; never pass it to a client component.
